sourceEvidenceLimitations: Each preserved observedResponse and case expectation was read against current v4 source files and the supplied full-diff.patch. Prior pass flags and 1.9.1 reviews were not treated as v4 pass evidence.

priorResponseSha256 is SHA-256 over each observedResponse encoded as UTF-8. Each sourceEvidence.sha256 is SHA-256 over the current working-tree file bytes. Git HEAD still points to the 1.9.1 baseline and is not a v4 content identifier.
This is a compatibility review of 80 preserved written responses, not 80 new model generations, plugin execution, real SillyTavern or device testing, or driver acceptance.

The 80 cases do not directly test the new independent worldbook-design-and-writing primary route, the prompt-spec contract, or the usable frontend greeting without duplicate prose. Their compatibility cannot prove those new capabilities.
